About Harborline Dental

Harborline Dental is owned and operated by Dr. Maren Calloway, who opened the practice after a decade of hospital dentistry. Our small team treats every patient like a neighbour.

We believe a visit to the dentist should be calm, unhurried and honest about costs.

Harborline Dental · 12 Example Quay, Port Ellery · Open Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm, and Saturday mornings by appointment.

Insurance accepted: most major dental plans. Financing available for larger treatments. Free parking behind the building.
